summary: SELTRACK Iteration 4 — Auth + Banks + Reasons + Payment Methods + Admin Dashboard + PIN-gated Reset. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases PASSED (100%). Frontend Playwright: 4/4 relevant flows PASSED, 1 correctly skipped (denomination grid — drawer-gated, unreachable in headless). Zero console errors observed. New pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_seltrack_new_features.py.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 728 lines — within reason but approaching the 700-line guideline threshold; consider splitting into routers/{auth,banks,shifts,txn,reports,admin}.py if further growth expected.
auth/change-password does not enforce a strong-password policy beyond min length 6; consider adding complexity checks or rate-limit.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook item). If exposed publicly, consider fail2ban-style throttle after N failed attempts per mobile within window.

seed_admin() is not idempotent w.r.t. rotated passwords — if INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD changes in .env, the existing admin's hash is NOT updated (per playbook guideline it should upsert). Currently only inserts when missing. Not a blocker but worth documenting.
adjust_bank_balance() has no ledger table — reversing a transaction (e.g., delete/void) is not implemented, so mistakes on UPI/BANK txns cannot be safely rolled back. This is a functional gap.
GET /api/reasons?category=<x> does not validate the category enum server-side (accepts any string, silently filters). Not a bug but Pydantic Literal would be safer.
POST /api/reasons creates reasons with no length limit — malicious label spam possible. Consider max length + trimming (trimming exists, length cap missing).
/api/admin/reset deletes counters but re-inserts on next receipt via find_one_and_update upsert — good pattern; verified working.
